initial.description: Prepare a clear notice for the affected audience. A preview is a local draft, and publication requires a separate wording review after the current audience and troubleshooting choice are fixed.
initial.subject: Workshop booking service is interrupted
initial.message: Some workshop bookings cannot be confirmed. Existing confirmations remain valid. The support team is reviewing the queue and will publish another update through the agreed communication channel.
initial.workaround: Keep the booking reference and contact the support desk before submitting the form again.

audiences.label: Notify affected customers
audiences.detail: Customers with bookings awaiting confirmation need a direct explanation and a usable next step.

audiences.label: Notify service staff
audiences.detail: The operations team needs the same factual update for its customer conversations.

audiences.label: Notify partner offices
audiences.detail: Partner offices have no affected bookings in this incident.

updates.description: The caller replaced the incident wording. Preserve valid draft choices, but discard the old preview and wording review so that revised content is previewed and approved again.
updates.subject: Workshop booking service is interrupted

updates.workaround: Ask the support desk to check the original booking reference before creating a replacement request.
